chunks: Masabih al-Nur of al-Mufid: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, from Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, from Abdallah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Abi Hashim Dawud ibn al-Qasim al-Ja'fari who said:

I presented to Abu Muhammad, the Master of the Army (peace be upon him), the book 'Yawm wa Layla' of Yunus. He said to me: 'Who authored this?' I said: 'It is authored by Yunus, the client of the family of Yaqtin.' He said: 'May Allah give him for every letter a light on the Day of Judgment.'

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْعَسْكَرِ: Title for Imam al-Askari, meaning 'Master of the Army'
key_terms.مَوْلَى آلِ يَقْطِينَ: Client/retainer of the family of Yaqtin
key_terms.يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ: Title of the book 'Day and Night' by Yunus

ai.seo_question: What was the Imam's praise for Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman regarding his book 'Yawm wa Layla'?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mashā'ir al-Nūr*, Dawud ibn al-Qasim al-Ja'fari presents Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman’s seminal work *Yawm wa Layla* to Imam al-Askari (AS), who confirms its authorship and bestows a specific spiritual reward. The Imam’s declaration that Allah will grant 'light for every letter' underscores the immense scholarly merit of Yunus, a key transmitter of hadith, and highlights the value of preserving religious knowledge in Shia tradition. This praise serves as an endorsement of *Yawm wa Layla* as a crucial text for understanding the attributes of the Imam and the Hereafter.

en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/282] Masabih al-Nur of al-Mufid: Abu al-Qasim Ja’far b. Muhammad b. Qulawayh from Ali b. al-Husayn b. Babawayh from Abdallah b. Ja’far al-Himyari from Abi Hashim Dawud b. al-Qasim al-Ja’fari who said:

I presented the book “Yawm wa Layla” of Yunus to Abi Muhammad al-Askari عليه السلام. He [the Imam] said to me: Who authored this? I said: It has been authored by Yunus the client of the family of Yaqtin. He said: May Allah give him for every letter a light on the day of judgment.
